                }

            }

        }

    public static boolean match(String s, int n) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(String.valueOf(n));
        while (sb.length() < s.length()) {
            sb.insert(0, '0');
        }
        String numStr = sb.toString();
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            char patternChar = s.charAt(i);
            char numChar = numStr.charAt(s.length() - 1 - i);
            if (patternChar == 'X') {
                continue;
            } else if (patternChar != '_') {
                if (patternChar != numChar) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

            char pc = pattern.charAt(i);
